# Roads beyond the reeds

Original fantasy events and readable books. Optional action and road games do not alter the supplied Scripture cards.

## tor-ferry · The fast boat · Thornwake Tor

The ferryman keeps one hand on the mooring rope. Beyond the reeds, a bell rings beneath an island of caves. “Fast ride to a dangerous shore? Your choice. I always leave room to bring you back.”

#### Success

The ferryman keeps one hand on the mooring rope. Beyond the reeds, a bell rings beneath an island of caves. “Fast ride to a dangerous shore? Your choice. I always leave room to bring you back.”

#### Short

The ferryman keeps one hand on the mooring rope. Beyond the reeds, a bell rings beneath an island of caves. “Fast ride to a dangerous shore? Your choice. I always leave room to bring you back.”

## whiteledge-greywing · A living stone bird · The rookery watcher

What looked like a small statue lifts its slate-colored crest. Beneath folded wings, its throat pulses. A greywing: one of the living stone birds. It opens its wings, then watches the northern canyon. A blue thread is caught around one talon.

#### Success

Its crest lifts as a bell sounds below the terraces. The greywing spreads a sail of warm, ribbed wing, then folds it again over the blue cloth. Far above, a second shadow passes along the cliff.

#### Short

The perched greywing opens one amber eye. A strip of blue caravan cloth stirs beneath its talon.
